title: PJTSAU Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 09 Graduate Teaching Assistant Posts
description: Professor Jayashankar Telangana State Agricultural University (PJTSAU) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill up the vacancies for 09 Graduate Teaching Assistant Jobs. Those who have completed their B.Sc. can grab this chance and apply for the PJTSAU Notification 2026 . Here we include the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
